purpose: Trace the first source-supported blocker before editorial or scientific promotion.

R-DAG-CAUSAL.required_evidence: versioned DAG schema plus negative-control fixture
R-DAG-CAUSAL.discriminating_test: engine distinguishes observed association from intervention

R-WEIGHTS-CALIBRATION.required_evidence: blinded benchmark, baseline models and pre-registered target metric
R-WEIGHTS-CALIBRATION.discriminating_test: weights retain performance outside calibration set

R-BOOTSTRAP-UQ.required_evidence: deterministic bootstrap implementation and frozen fixture

R-ANTIDERIVATIVE-BOUNDARY.required_evidence: boundary schema, constants, origin and ambiguity report
R-ANTIDERIVATIVE-BOUNDARY.discriminating_test: incompatible admissible boundaries cannot be promoted as same reconstruction

R-LOGLOG-COMPETITION.required_evidence: frozen synthetic/real fixtures with power-law alternatives
R-LOGLOG-COMPETITION.discriminating_test: compare power-law against exponential, lognormal and segmented alternatives

R-SOURCE-INDEPENDENCE.required_evidence: lineage_id authority and deduplication rules across repositories
R-SOURCE-INDEPENDENCE.discriminating_test: known shared dataset is never counted as independent replication

R-VECTOR-CORPUS.required_evidence: privacy-preserving authorized manifest with order and hash chain
R-VECTOR-CORPUS.discriminating_test: declared corpus reconstructs from authorized chunks without exposing private content

R-SEMANTIC-HUMAN-STUDY.required_evidence: independent ethics/privacy approval plus consent flow before participant data
R-SEMANTIC-HUMAN-STUDY.discriminating_test: do not execute study until governance prerequisite is satisfied

R-FRACTAL-DIMENSION.required_evidence: estimator, surrogate null, pre-registered scale interval and replicated measurement
R-FRACTAL-DIMENSION.discriminating_test: scaling survives surrogate data and alternative estimator comparison

R-EXTERNAL-VALIDATION.required_evidence: frozen reproduction bundle with acceptance criteria
R-EXTERNAL-VALIDATION.discriminating_test: independent run reproduces the pre-registered effect

external_method_reference.use: methodological inspiration for separation, traceback and reconstruction only
